item.content:encoded: While better than the original story on account of it being filtered through something I like, it's still A Christmas Carol, and these changes aren't enough for me to enjoy it fully overall. That's really the only issue you have here, but I can't turn into a reformed Scrooge to upvote it. Though I can't downvote, given how clear it is both how much effort and time and care went into it, as wel as the quality that's shown. Most crossovers/adaptations involving the Foundation stop at the first step, and you clearly keep going forward with it. So good job.

item.title: Merry 11 Days Before Christmas!
item.content:encoded:
I was planning on holding off on this one a little longer, but I'm going to be out of town in the next few days and wanted to make sure I got it up when I needed to.

First, some credits. Obviously this tale is inspired extremely heavily by various scripts and adaptations of "A Christmas Carol" by Charles Dickens. If you haven't seen it yet, find a local theatre troupe and watch their performance of it (they're almost definitely performing it). It's one of my favorite plays, and I think you'll enjoy it too.

All images used (except the title bar) are from SunnyClockwork, and they are dope.

Edit: Also thanks to psul below for catching things I had missed, as well as noting a much needed improvement.

Lastly, thanks to everybody who had a glance at this in chat and approved (or otherwise). I know this isn't going to be for everyone, and I respect if you don't want to slog through the whole thing, but I really enjoyed writing it and I hope you enjoy reading it, too.

Merry (Early) Christmas!
